purpose: Determine whether one exactly pinned OpenCode CLI deployment can become a third measured Track B harness without weakening the shared task, verifier, isolation or measurement boundary.

decision.reason: Documentation and package metadata establish plausibility, not benchmark equivalence. The exact binary, configuration schema, event stream, hidden model-call behavior and sandbox boundary still require executable qualification.

package_lock_candidate.lock_rule: The accepted package, transitive dependency lock, executable hash and reported CLI version must be frozen before any model smoke.

official_source_evidence.claim: OpenCode documents direct Ollama provider configuration and local model selection.
The CLI documents noninteractive opencode run and a JSON output format.
Agent configuration exposes granular permissions for tools and external directories.
OpenCode includes hidden built-in agents used for tasks such as compaction, titles and summaries.
Automatic compaction is enabled by default and includes a model-generated summary.
The CLI documents environment controls for default plugins, LSP downloads, auto-compaction, Claude Code compatibility and model-list fetching.

known_documentation_risk.description: The official documentation exposes concurrent URL and configuration surfaces. The qualification must treat the pinned package's own help output and observed behavior as authoritative for this package version.
known_documentation_risk.required_action: Freeze opencode --version, relevant --help output, resolved configuration, executable hash and a minimal no-inference invocation before implementing the adapter.

required_isolation.sessions: must not persist outside the ignored run directory
required_isolation.allowed_network: the one declared Ollama loopback origin only
required_isolation.sandbox_backend: a separately versioned executable boundary that passes the same adversarial intent as the Pi Seatbelt checks

required_tool_policy.bash: the one frozen public-test command only

hidden_model_call_policy.requirement: Every model request caused by the harness must be absent or included in raw trajectory and token accounting.

qualification_sequence.acceptance: Exact package, transitive lock, binary hash, version and relevant help output are frozen.
A project-owned configuration selects only Ollama and the intended tools without reading user-global state.
The adapter can attribute CLI events and prove the intended request boundary before a real model is used.
Read, write, symlink, child-process, executable, home-secret, repository-write and network probes all enforce the declared boundary.
One preregistered model-task attempt yields attributable events, bounded tools, a valid termination record and separate final verification.

qualification_failures: cannot isolate user-global state or instructions
cannot prevent undeclared plugins, skills, MCP servers or subagents
cannot restrict tool paths and the public-test command
cannot deny external network while allowing only local Ollama
cannot disable or account for hidden model calls
cannot persist a complete attributable event stream
cannot distinguish process exit, agent termination and verifier outcome
pinned package behavior conflicts with the shared Track B protocol

planned_smoke.model_selection_rule: Choose only after no-inference qualification; prefer a deployment already observed under Mini and Pi so the smoke isolates harness behavior.
